MQTT_Server.label: MQTT Server
MQTT_Server.description: This object defines configuration parameters for an MQTT client to interact with a MQTT server.

Will_Retain.label: Will Retain
Will_Retain.description: The Will Retain value to declare in the MQTT CONNECT message.

Will_Topic.label: Will Topic
Will_Topic.description: The Will Topic to include in the MQTT CONNECT message.

Will_Message.label: Will Message
Will_Message.description: The Will Message to include in the MQTT CONNECT message.

Clean_Session.label: Clean Session
Clean_Session.description: The Clean Session value to declare in the MQTT CONNECT message.

Will_QoS.label: Will QoS
Will_QoS.description: The Will QoS value to declare in the MQTT CONNECT message.

Keep_Alive.label: Keep Alive
Keep_Alive.description: The Keep Alive value to declare in the MQTT CONNECT message.

Client_Identifier.label: Client Identifier
Client_Identifier.description: The Client Identifier identifies the MQTT client to the MQTT server. MQTT server must support ClientIds which are between 1 and 23 UTF-8 encoded bytes in length, and that contain only the characters "0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ". MQTT server may allow ClientId's that contain more than 23 encoded bytes and may support ClientId's that contain characters not included in the list.

User_Name.label: User Name
User_Name.description: The User Name to declare in the MQTT CONNECT message. It must be a UTF-8 encoded string. It can be used by the MQTT server for authentication and authorization.

Password.label: Password
Password.description: The Password value to declare in the MQTT CONNECT message.
